dtype: BF16 weights and activations; Candle default F32 GEMM accumulation, reduced-precision flags false; last logits returned F32 then MLPL F64 sampling
residency: model and KV cache native CUDA; one vocabulary vector copied per generated token
template: boxed-v1; CoT appends two newlines then Explain step by step.
verifier: choice-v2; complete nonempty boxed answers from EOS-completed candidates only
rng: MLPL random: xorshift64 (13,7,17), upper 53 bits / 2^53; discard 16 startup uniforms; one stream per call; seeds 42..51; greedy seed 42 unused
deadline_implementation: checked between synchronous token operations; outer timeout terminates a stuck job; small in-flight operation overshoot is recorded
schedule: case index order; method groups rotated by index modulo 3; direct=0, CoT=1, voting=2; ten voting seeds ascending
warmup: The capital of France is; greedy two tokens; excluded from scores
reference_check: one non-evaluation five-token prompt; 151936 logits; F32 max 7.1162e-6; BF16 max 0.367154; all variants choose 12095
portability: SDK git revision replaces absolute dependency; source local external archive, sibling publication awaiting authorization
